verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside 1Password. Watchtower's security alerts and the password generator are rule-based features, not AI, so they are adjacent at best. The MCP servers and llms.txt serve external agents and docs consumers, not in-product AI insights over the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
